newsitem.title: USA: Unicom unit plans nuclear plant operating changes.
newsitem.headline: Unicom unit plans nuclear plant operating changes.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co (ComEd), a unit of Unicom Corp, said Thursday it is addressing issues raised in an independent assessment of operations at its LaSalle and Zion nuclear power plants.

ComEd said a team of 17 industry leaders found shortcomings in four fundamental categories -- poor performance, inconsistent commitment to excellence and to standards, and ineffective leadership and management skills.
The company said the concerns mirrored issues identified by federal regulators.
At a public hearing, the utility said it has already launched operational changes, including additional training and hardware improvements.

The Nuclear Regulatory Commission placed Zion and LaSalle on its watch list in January earlier this month and has been discussing with the utility apparent violations at ComEd's Quad Cities nuclear power station.
The NRC is scheduled to hold a public hearing Friday on its latest assessment of ComEd's Dresden power plant.
Unicom shares were down 1/8 Thursday at 22-7/8.
